parameters.name: BudgetName
parameters.description: The name of the budget. Supports fuzzy search.

parameters.name: BudgetStatus
parameters.description: The status of the budget. If you do not specify this parameter, budgets in all statuses are returned.

parameters.name: BudgetType
parameters.description: The type of the budget. If you do not specify this parameter, budgets of all types are returned.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return. Valid values: 1 to 10. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. Set this parameter to the NextToken value that is returned in the response to the previous request. If you do not specify this parameter, the query starts from the first page.
